title: Cadence
tagline: A managed subscription billing engine built on Nomba's payment APIs for Nigerian developers.
highlights: Designed a 7-State Billing Machine to eliminate the need for developers to write custom state machines from scratch.
Decoupled the automated dunning scheduler into an independent cron process to avoid blocking the main web server.
Orchestrated tokenized card authorizations and webhooks securely using Nomba's payment primitives.
